prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision involving your insured. Our client was injured in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical treatment for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing.

We request that you provide the full bodily injury liability limits under the policy covering your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other policies that may apply.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes the insured's recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and total loss records, claim file materials, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Preservation of this evidence is required, and any loss or alteration of it may result in sanctions. We ask that you confirm in writing within ten days that these materials are being preserved.
